name: GEVS shortened shuffle sequence (data, not choreography)
description: step R×2, step L×2, heel R, heel L, quarter turn — repeated ×2. Prompt list + timing only; no motion data. Original line-dance primitives, no copyrighted choreography.

phrases.label: step-r2
phrases.prompt: a person steps to the right twice

phrases.label: step-l2
phrases.prompt: a person steps to the left twice

phrases.label: heel-r
phrases.prompt: a person taps their right heel forward

phrases.label: heel-l
phrases.prompt: a person taps their left heel forward

phrases.label: quarter-turn
phrases.prompt: a person turns a quarter turn to the left
